title: New teeth, school bands and leaving for San Francisco
summary: With Bill Russell's help Bunk got teeth, taught three school bands until about 1942, then went to San Francisco in 1942-43; his Texas playing was in the old days.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: And so I think when Louis Armstrong came by, he was in the rice field then. He had quit there and he went to the rice field then. Yeah, I think he must have been there. And after that, well, you started writing to him. Bill Russell started writing to him and everything. That's where he got together and he got his teeth. And then after that, he went and seen the school board. For us. D-Loyd Porter. And he was talking to him about putting up a band, a little school band, teaching school children. So then he had two bands. He had one in Generic, one school band in Generic, and one in New Iberia Elementary School, and one in high school. He had three bands altogether. Then he taught that until 42, I think it was.
Yes, and I still had it in 1942 when Gene Williams came down.
Yeah, I think it was in 42. But in 42 or 43, he went to Frisco.
Yeah, 43, I remember. I have that pretty well lined up in his letters.
Yeah, well, that's when he went to Frisco.

I met him in 1942, so from then on I knew pretty well. But even at that, I didn't know every place he played. Sometime when he'd go back to New Iberia, somebody up in New York or someplace would say they heard that Bunk was playing over in Texas. He played a job or something even over in Texas.
Yeah, he played in Texas. He played in Beaumont, Port Arthur, and all little surrounding places.
In late years was that too, or just in the old days when you first met him?

No, that was just in the old days when I first met him. Somebody told me that? After he got to New Iberia, he didn't go back up there to play. Not for any time. Unless the band, unless he would go out with Gus and them, who would have a date like that or something like that. But he never did go back out there.
